subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is an anthropomorphic light-brown short-haired rabbit, wearing black-framed glasses, a white short-sleeve shirt, and a blue lanyard work badge, seated on a black office chair; round cheeks, long upright ears, small nose, innocent yet sly micro-expression.
<Subject 2> is an anthropomorphic tabby cat, wearing a blue striped shirt, a beige knit vest, and a work badge, seated at an office desk; distinct tabby stripes, alert ears, expressive amber eyes, initially puzzled and resigned, later shocked and崩溃.

summary:
A 15-second cartoon-realistic office comedy: a rabbit asks a tabby cat for 10 yuan to help an elderly street vendor, the cat is moved and gives the money, then discovers the “sad calls” were actually a roast gluten skewer sales pitch.

retention_analysis:
No external reference media provided. Retain text-defined character identities, clothing, props, office layout, warm color palette, and continuous spatial orientation across all eight shots.

detailed_description:
The entire film is a 16:9 cartoon-realistic hybrid anthropomorphic pet short comedy set in a modern bright open-plan office, with unified warm indoor soft light from floor-to-ceiling windows on the right, realistic office desks, computers, keyboards, file racks, green plants, and blurred colleague background; the locked palette uses #F5C77E as warm key tone, #6B4F3A for shadows, and #FFF3D6 for highlights, with consistent fine grain and soft warm LUT across every shot.

[Shot 1] A medium eye-level shot, static with a very slight slow push in. <Subject 1> sits on a black office chair, leans forward, and looks earnestly at <Subject 2> across the desk. The rabbit’s glasses catch soft window light, the blue lanyard badge rests on the white shirt, and the office background stays readable but softly blurred. <Subject 1> (S1) says <d>你有没有10块钱呀?</d> Ambient office hum and a faint chair creak continue.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.800, the camera cuts to a medium eye-level shot. <Subject 2> sits at the desk, arms crossed, brow furrowed, looking at <Subject 1> with confusion. The tabby cat’s blue striped shirt and beige knit vest remain clear; keyboard and file rack sit in soft focus. <Subject 2> (S2) says <d>你要干吗呀?</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:03.400, the camera cuts to a close-up. <Subject 1> faces the camera slightly, eyes wide and innocent, expression sincere. Warm light wraps the rabbit’s light-brown fur and black-framed glasses. <Subject 1> (S1) says <d>门口有个大爷, 叫得可惨了, 我想帮帮他.</d> A quiet office breath and distant keyboard taps remain under the line.

[Shot 4] At 00:05.200, the camera cuts to a medium shot. <Subject 2> is visibly moved, gives a resigned sigh, lowers the head, opens a brown wallet, and pulls out a 10 yuan note. The cat hands the note toward <Subject 1>; the wallet clasp clicks, paper slides softly. <Subject 2> (S2) says <d>你还挺有爱心啊.</d>

[Shot 5] At 00:07.200, the camera cuts to a close-up. <Subject 1> quickly takes the money, eyes lighting up, and smiles brightly. The rabbit’s paws hold the 10 yuan note close; the blue lanyard and white shirt stay visible. <Subject 1> (S1) says <d>谢谢你啦!</d> A small fabric rustle and bright office ambience continue.

[Shot 6] At 00:08.600, the camera cuts to a medium shot. <Subject 2> suddenly remembers something, tilts the head, and looks at <Subject 1> with renewed confusion. The cat’s ears angle forward, tail still, office plants and blurred colleagues behind. <Subject 2> (S2) says <d>他怎么叫来着?</d>

[Shot 7] At 00:10.200, the camera cuts to a close-up. <Subject 1> becomes very serious, opens the mouth, and imitates a street vendor with full commitment. The rabbit’s innocent face contrasts with the absurd sales pitch; warm key light stays locked. <Subject 1> (S1) says <d>烤面筋, 烤面筋, 10块钱两串!</d>

[Shot 8] At 00:12.600, the camera cuts to a tight close-up on <Subject 2>, with a very slight low angle and a small slow pull out. The tabby cat freezes, then both paws shoot to the head, eyes wide, pupils shaking, tail snaps upright, mouth open in exaggerated shock and disbelief. The office background blurs further as the comedic beat lands. No dialogue. The final frame holds until 00:15.000.

overall_soundscape:
A continuous modern office soundscape: soft air-conditioning hum, distant keyboard typing, muffled colleague chatter, chair casters rolling, fabric rustle, a wallet clasp click, and a paper note sliding. Non-verbal vocal details include a small breath, a resigned sigh, a quick intake of air, and a sharp comic gasp. The final beat leaves a brief stunned silence under the room tone.

non_diegetic_music:
Light, playful cartoon-realistic comedy score with pizzicato strings, xylophone, and soft percussion. The tempo stays bouncy through the request and wallet moment, then lands on a sharp comedic stinger at the final shocked reaction.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.800, the camera cuts to a medium eye-level shot. <Subject 2> sits at the desk, arms crossed, brow furrowed, looking at <Subject 1> with confusion. The tabby cat’s blue striped shirt and beige knit vest remain clear; keyboard and file rack sit in soft focus. <Subject 2> (S2) says <d>你要干吗呀?</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:03.400, the camera cuts to a close-up. <Subject 1> faces the camera slightly, eyes wide and innocent, expression sincere. Warm light wraps the rabbit’s light-brown fur and black-framed glasses. <Subject 1> (S1) says <d>门口有个大爷, 叫得可惨了, 我想帮帮他.</d> A quiet office breath and distant keyboard taps remain under the line.

[Shot 4] At 00:05.200, the camera cuts to a medium shot. <Subject 2> is visibly moved, gives a resigned sigh, lowers the head, opens a brown wallet, and pulls out a 10 yuan note. The cat hands the note toward <Subject 1>; the wallet clasp clicks, paper slides softly. <Subject 2> (S2) says <d>你还挺有爱心啊.</d>

[Shot 5] At 00:07.200, the camera cuts to a close-up. <Subject 1> quickly takes the money, eyes lighting up, and smiles brightly. The rabbit’s paws hold the 10 yuan note close; the blue lanyard and white shirt stay visible. <Subject 1> (S1) says <d>谢谢你啦!</d> A small fabric rustle and bright office ambience continue.

[Shot 6] At 00:08.600, the camera cuts to a medium shot. <Subject 2> suddenly remembers something, tilts the head, and looks at <Subject 1> with renewed confusion. The cat’s ears angle forward, tail still, office plants and blurred colleagues behind. <Subject 2> (S2) says <d>他怎么叫来着?</d>

[Shot 7] At 00:10.200, the camera cuts to a close-up. <Subject 1> becomes very serious, opens the mouth, and imitates a street vendor with full commitment. The rabbit’s innocent face contrasts with the absurd sales pitch; warm key light stays locked. <Subject 1> (S1) says <d>烤面筋, 烤面筋, 10块钱两串!</d>

[Shot 8] At 00:12.600, the camera cuts to a tight close-up on <Subject 2>, with a very slight low angle and a small slow pull out. The tabby cat freezes, then both paws shoot to the head, eyes wide, pupils shaking, tail snaps upright, mouth open in exaggerated shock and disbelief. The office background blurs further as the comedic beat lands. No dialogue. The final frame holds until 00:15.000.
